      ∀ (ι : Type*) (D : PhaseJetBounds.Domain ι Slow)

        (∀ j i, LargeBand h M u ((a j).band i)) →
      ∀ i : ι, N ≤ (a 0).band i → ∀ p ∈ D.carrier i, ∀ T : Plane,
        ((a 0).c0 i, (a 0).K i, T) ∈ modelSet M u eta →
      ∀ zeta : ℝ, 0 ≤ zeta →
        ZeroOrderBounds (Real.sqrt (ChartScales.S ((a 0).band i)))
